title: Big Claims, Small Margins: Do Reported GraphLLM Gains Survive Simple Baselines?
abstract: arXiv:2610.28714v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based methods for node classification on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) routinely report state-of-the-art accuracy. We ask how these results compare with inexpensive baselines run on the same splits. On the splits of three recent studies, we tune four baseline representatives with validation-only selection and compare them with the highest mean that each paper reports for an LLM-based method in the matched setting. Correct & Smooth on TF-IDF features trails this reference by a median of 2.3 percentage points, and an MLP on frozen e5-large-v2 embeddings by 2.8 points. Correct & Smooth is within 3 points of the reference or better on 15 of 24 tasks, but the reference is significantly higher on 12 of 22 testable tasks, so several reported gains remain substantial. translated_title: 高调宣称，微小差距：GraphLLM报告的性能提升能否经受简单基线的检验？
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法在文本属性图（TAG）节点分类任务上经常报告最先进的准确率。我们探究这些结果与在相同数据划分上运行的低成本基线相比表现如何。在三篇近期研究的数据划分上，我们仅使用验证集进行选择来调优四个基线代表方法，并将它们与各论文在匹配设置下为基于LLM方法报告的最高平均性能进行比较。基于TF-IDF特征的Correct & Smooth方法与该参考值的中位数差距为2.3个百分点，基于冻结e5-large-v2嵌入的MLP差距为2.8个百分点。在24个任务中的15个上，Correct & Smooth与参考值的差距在3个百分点以内或更优，但在22个可测试任务中的12个上参考值显著更高，因此若干已报告的性能提升仍然可观。通过对照论文阅读其公开代码，我们还记录了评估风险：在测试集上选择超参数或检查点、测试池节点的标签被用于训练。
tldr: 该研究发现简单基线（Correct & Smooth和MLP）在文本属性图节点分类上与最先进GraphLLM方法的差距中位数仅约2-3个百分点，并揭示了部分已发表研究存在测试集选择超参数、测试标签泄露等评估风险。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that simple baselines (Correct & Smooth and MLP) trail state-of-the-art GraphLLM methods by median margins of only 2-3 percentage points on text-attributed graph node classification, and documents evaluation risks such as test-set hyperparameter selection and test-label leakage in published studies.
